method: Delete only ASCII JSON whitespace outside strings, retain final LF. All strings, escapes, literal numbers, keys, values and array order are unchanged. Complete originals remain at original_complete_commit. This formats metadata and executes no scientific target.
reference_filter: Exclude whole root/topic path, complete parent path, unique leaf, whole original SHA256 or Git blob references in every other current tracked or untracked Python/JSON/YAML/shell/JavaScript/TypeScript/Markdown file under this topic and .github, plus root README/AGENTS, including all published and new actual manifests/workflows. Repeat this check after every pull before push.
